title: Mai Nasara Tsakanin Sarakuna Biyu
intro: A cikin tarihin jagorancin Allah, mutum ɗaya ya bambanta a matsayin babban mai mulki da kuma bawan Allah mai tawali'u. Wannan mutum ya yi tafiya zuwa mafi nisan duniya, yana ganin fitowar rana a kan wasu mutane marasa ban mamaki kuma ya faɗi a cikin wani baƙar maɓuɓɓugar ruwa mai duhu. Mafi ban mamaki, an ba wannan bawa aikin gina shinge mai ban mamaki ga al'ummar da ke da babban ɓarna. Za ku iya gano wannan mutum mai tatsuniya daga Alƙur'ani?
clues: Mai rahama ya ba ni iko da tasiri a duniya
Na yi tafiya zuwa wurin da rana ke fitowa da kuma inda take faɗuwa
Na isa ga mutanen da ba su fahimci kalma ɗaya ba
An umarce ni da in gina babban shinge ta amfani da ƙarfe
Na rufe sararin da ke tsakanin tsaunuka biyu masu tsayi da ƙarfe mai narkewa
Ban kasance mala'ika ba kuma ba annabi ba, sai dai bawa wanda Allah ya yi masa ni'ima.

trial.label: Babban Aikin
options: Gina babban shingen ƙarfe a kan Yajuj da Majuj
Tona rijiya mai zurfi ga masu adalci
Gina jirgin ruwa a lokacin ambaliyar ruwa mai tsanani
trial.answer: Gina babban shingen ƙarfe a kan Yajuj da Majuj

location.label: Saitin
options: Wurin fitowar rana da kuma baƙar maɓuɓɓugar laka
location.answer: Wurin fitowar rana da kuma baƙar maɓuɓɓugar laka

outcome.label: Alkawari Mai Tsarki
options: An bayar da aljanna ta har abada nan take
Iska mai zafi ta lalata ƙasar
Katangar za ta dawwama har zuwa Ranar Kiyama
'Yanci daga mutuwa ga dukkan masu imani
Mulki madawwami ba tare da iyaka ba
outcome.answer: Shamakin zai dawwama har zuwa Ranar Kiyama

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّۭا
verse: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?" (18:94)
